title: Ford's new NSA intelligence system

tellings.quote: But first of all, we want you to arrange with the NSA a new intelligence system

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former advisor to US presidents, says that in 1974 at the White House, President Gerald Ford and his aide Bill Seidman asked him to set up a new intelligence system with the NSA, the US agency that gathers secret electronic intelligence. He tells it to show how close he was to sensitive government work, which would make his other claims about handling UFO material more weighty.
